releaseNotes:
• Floating Album Set Indicator Bar: Recreated with bottom navbar liquid glass blur & refraction (no inner pill)
• True Full-Screen Lyrics: Expanded dynamic viewport with auto-hiding compact cover and controls
• Next Up Control Pills: Replaced switch with Shuffle, Repeat, AutoMix & Autoplay interactive glass pills
• Infinite Next Up Queue: Continuous dynamic background track fetching on scroll
• Contextual Search Recommendations: Next Up strictly follows searched song, artist, language & genre
• Bollywood Top Charts Cleansing: Purged foreign/BTS tracks to enforce authentic Bollywood selections
• Lightning-Fast Art Loading: Coil network connection pooling with hardware bitmap decoding
• Zero-Lag Homescreen Setup: Heavy caching and recommendations pre-warmed during onboarding
• Snappy Player Minimize: Accelerated navbar & mini media player return animation
• AirPods-Style Update Dialog: Redesigned bottom-sheet popup with scrollable changelog
• Refreshed Banner Removal: Eliminated redundant refresh success cards on homescreen
• Onboarding Logo Refinement: Reduced initial app opening logo size by 50%
